text:
Situation: Our naproxen 250 mg tablets (NDC 68462018805) are supplied by Glenmark sites with recent regulatory actions. Corvale East has 19.5 days on hand (363 units); Corvale General has 13.6 days (251 units). Three Class II recalls have been initiated since 2021, including ongoing recalls from 2023-11-07 and 2025-03-13 for labeling mix-ups and CGMP deviations.

Why (FDA record): The US site (FEI 3011585599) received OAI on 2022-05-19, a Warning Letter on 2023-06-20, and VAI on 2025-06-17. The Colvale, India site (FEI 3008565058) received OAI on 2025-02-14 and a Warning Letter on 2025-07-11. The Pithampur, India site (FEI 3004672766) received OAI on 2022-05-20, a Warning Letter on 2022-11-22, and VAI on 2026-06-30. Naproxen is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply risk is elevated due to site compliance histories and active recalls. Alternative sources not on the FDA shortage list are available for immediate procurement.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (ACTAVIS LABS FL INC.) — approved by Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to place orders with A-S Medication Solutions (last inspection VAI 2026-08-12) — approved by Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to evaluate ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, and Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC for formulary addition — approved by P&T Committee.

Not recommended: Continuing sole reliance on current Glenmark supply without qualified backup contracts.
